run_history: No docs/ux-walker/run-history.json existed at consolidation; no prior pass is assumed.
notes: This is a plan, not an execution result.
Blocked is an explicit extension to the skill action vocabulary so absent fixtures cannot be treated as skips or passes.
Primary paths may run while listed external variants remain blocked; never label the whole branch inventory verified.
Authentication recovery uses the designated synthetic local account only; sign-out runs last.
STORY-005 dependencies mean schedule after all runnable authenticated stories; blocked stories do not prevent sign-out cleanup.

order.reason: No previous run-history entry; walk safely available primary path.
blocked_or_excluded_branches: Local bypass does not prove SMS delivery.
order.result_scope: Auth/callback passed originally; original mobile list failure resolved by separate post-fix history walk (016).

order.reason: No previous run-history entry; walk safely available primary path.

order.reason: No previous run-history entry; walk safely available primary path.

order.title: Search the model catalog and leave the current model unchanged
order.preconditions: Signed in on `/`; model catalog service available for populated results. No model selection is required or authorized by this story.
order.ideal_path: 3 — open the chooser, inspect/search options, dismiss it.

blocked_or_excluded_branches: Model setting mutation is excluded from this walk.

order.title: Inspect connector actions and recover from an unavailable return
order.preconditions: Signed in. Primary error-display path can be checked locally using the rendered callback-state URL; it does not simulate or prove OAuth execution. A real Connect success path requires a working deployment connector and a separately designated synthetic provider account. A Disconnect path requires that test account to be connected already.
order.ideal_path: 2 — reach the connection state and see actionable success/failure information after an attempted connection.
order.reason: No previous run-history entry; walk safely available primary path.
blocked_or_excluded_branches: Callback query parameter checks only banner presentation, not executed OAuth.
Connect/disconnect grants remain blocked without test connectors.
order.result_scope: Direct callback-banner presentation only; real OAuth/grants/disconnect blocked.

order.title: Understand the iMessage handoff without sending a message
order.preconditions: Signed in on `/`. Current local unavailable state is walkable; the enabled handoff requires a configured Linq connector and assigned test line, plus an OS handler for `sms:` links. No message should be sent.
order.ideal_path: 2 — inspect availability and, when configured, open the system messaging handoff.
order.reason: Walk disabled-state branch only; configured native handoff blocked without assigned test line and OS handler.
blocked_or_excluded_branches: Enabled sms handoff blocked without configured test line; no message sending.
order.result_scope: Disabled iMessage visible; no configured test-line handoff.

order.title: Keep administration unavailable to a regular member
order.preconditions: Signed-in synthetic non-admin account; its phone is not included in the deployment admin allow-list.

order.title: Start a conversation, continue it, and reload
order.preconditions: Authenticated synthetic account at `/chat`; working local Eve and model connection. Use text-only, non-external prompts. If the runtime fails, record the failure rather than substituting a source claim.
order.ideal_path: 5 — Enter and submit the first message, enter and submit a follow-up, reload to verify continuity.
order.reason: Requires functional local inference; use only the story text and stop/report if runtime fails.
order.result_scope: First turn has no answer/error; follow-up replies; original failure unresolved.

order.title: Stop a response and continue, or recover from a failed turn
order.preconditions: Owned synthetic `/chat/[sessionId]` with an established history; functioning runtime and a response long enough to expose `Stop`. Do not create artificial infrastructure outages or send external-action prompts.
order.ideal_path: 5 — Enter and submit a request, stop it, enter and submit the shorter request.
order.reason: Requires owned conversation and cancellable active response; do not induce outages.
order.result_scope: Stop attempted; subsequent short follow-up clears without delivery; POST409 observed; cancellation acceptance unknown.

order.title: Save personal information and recover from validation feedback
order.preconditions: Authenticated synthetic account with an empty or explicitly disposable profile at `/personal-info`; never overwrite an existing real profile.
order.ideal_path: 4 — Enter first name, email, and country code, then save; validation/reload are verification variations.
order.reason: Confirm profile is empty or explicitly disposable before any save; otherwise block.
order.result_scope: Invalid country rejected; synthetic values saved and retained after reload.

order.title: Add a passwordless synthetic login and find its metadata
order.preconditions: Authenticated synthetic account at `/vault`, disposable synthetic vault fixture, working vault storage. No real credentials. Use a fresh unique label if the named fixture already exists.
order.ideal_path: 6 — Open Logins, choose Add login, fill three required values, save.
order.reason: Confirm disposable vault scope and working storage before adding passwordless synthetic login; otherwise block.
blocked_or_excluded_branches: No credentials or real vault plaintext.
order.result_scope: Passwordless synthetic login created; matching/nonmatching search; reopening variant untested.

order.title: Answer a question or review a conditional action request
order.preconditions: An owned synthetic conversation contains a real pending structured question generated by the runtime or an existing approved local fixture. A normal text question is not equivalent. Approval/authorization variations require their own isolated fixture and are blocked if none exists; do not induce real purchases, messages, deletion, or third-party grants.
order.ideal_path: 2 — Select an option or type an answer, then activate `Answer`.
order.reason: Requires an existing pending structured question or approved isolated runtime fixture; authorization/approval branches need separate fixtures.
blocked_or_excluded_branches: Real action approvals and account grants excluded; only existing isolated fixtures.
order.result_scope: No existing pending structured question/approval fixture.

order.title: Review a completed assignment and its conversation context
order.preconditions: An owned designated synthetic browser trace and its known parent chat already exist. Older-trace/message pagination requires sufficiently large fixtures. If no trace fixture exists, this story is blocked; do not launch a real browser job to satisfy it.
order.ideal_path: 3 — open Tasks, choose the assignment, and read its details; conversation context is a separate deliberate check.
order.reason: Requires an owned populated synthetic browser trace and known parent chat; current empty traces cannot cover it.
order.result_scope: No owned populated real browser-trace/context fixture; mocked list is not runtime proof.

order.ideal_path: 2 — Open its category and remove the clearly identified disposable item.
order.reason: Requires exact designated disposable Contact info row; do not delete other records.
order.result_scope: No exact disposable Contact info deletion fixture.

order.result_scope: No isolated designated admin overview fixture.
